                    route = new_route
                    base_cost += delta
                    improved = True
                    break

def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_list = instance["customer_ids"]

    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    # Helpers
    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def feasible_append_load(load_a, load_b):
        return load_a + load_b <= capacity

    # 1) Clarke-Wright savings with deterministic sorting and capacity checks
    unassigned = set(customers_list)
    if not unassigned:

    customers = list(unassigned)

    routes = [[c] for c in customers]
    loads = {i: demands[c] for i, c in enumerate(customers)}  # route index -> load

    # savings(i,j) = d(depot,i)+d(depot,j)-d(i,j)
    savings = []

    for a in range(n):
        i = customers[a]
        di = matrix[depot][i]
        for b in range(a + 1, n):
            j = customers[b]
            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]

            savings.append((s, i, j))

        return -1

            return False

        loads[ra] = loads[ra] + loads[rb]
